market_question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?
reasoning: Current WTI forward curve for mid-2026 is around $64, making a touch of $115 in a single month an extreme 80%+ spike. Even with high volatility, the monthly probability of such a move is near zero; the market price of 41% vastly overstates the true chance.
evidence_points: Forward price for July 2026 active contract likely near $64, well below $115
WTI monthly implied volatility ~9% makes $115 a >6-sigma event from the forward price
Historical spikes above $115 are rare, coincide with major disruptions, and rarely hit a pre-specified month
